relations.statement: Two regimes agree on datum counts and form tables, and have membership-equal instance, rule and requirement collections (list-as-set extensionality).
relations.hypotheses: Equal datum counts; equal indexed form tables; membership equivalence of instances, rules, requirements.

lemmas.statement: Under RegimeExt, derivability in the two regimes coincides.
